title: DingusCube
description: Turns everyone into a cube with the skin of a person named Dingus
body:
Turns players into cubes by Dingus

Command is /Dingus to turn it off

The cube is a slime the slime is in the mod the mod is small.

This mod was made for memes and wont change anything in terms of gameplay
~~NOTE: the username is messed up so you cannot see other players usernames when enabled.~~


You can put this into any mod idc
